purpose: One-time read-only account billing-history snapshot to inspect billed and payable line items omitted by the existing subscription and usage snapshots.

execution.history_check: Require exactly one workflow run total; it must be this first-attempt main dispatch.
execution.pagination: Sequential pages only when result_info requires them; stop at the hard page or item cap and report incomplete coverage.

persist_only: action, type, status and currency categories

allowed_operations: One GitHub Actions workflow-history metadata request.
At most ten sequential read-only Cloudflare account billing-history requests.
Secret-free short-retention report artifact and Actions summary.
forbidden_operations: Any rerun, retry, redirect following, fallback endpoint, status filtering, or request beyond the page cap.
Persisting raw response, account identity, item/invoice identifiers, hosted invoice URLs, or descriptions.
Invoice/payment-method/profile/member access beyond fields returned by the specified read-only history endpoint.
Any create, update, delete, purchase, plan change, D1/R2 access, provider access, training, holdout access, Cloud Paper execution, or schedule activation.
Any conclusion that this history snapshot alone proves zero total account/project cost or all current/future writers are covered.
